CustomField.label: Status ärger?
CustomField.description: Three-state AErger-Indicator at the customer (SCRUM-442, AC5). "Kein Daten" if no closed Case in the 3-month window (PO-Decision: must NOT read as satisfied); "AErger" if the 3-month average is below 3.0 OR at least one Case with score 1 or 2 in the window (min <= 2); else "OK". The no-data branch keys on Satisfaction_Anzahl__c = 0, NOT ISBLANK(avg): the platform enum TreatBlanksAs has NO BlankAsNull (deploy-validate rejected it; valid: BlankAsZero/BlankAsBlank/#N/A) and under BlankAsZero a blank avg reads 0 < 3 — which would flag every customer without closed Cases as AErger. The Rebuilder always writes the count, so count=0 is equivalent to no data, and the avg/min branch is never reached with blanks. House shape SCRUM-398 Eskalationsstufe__c (BlankAsZero, deployed green).
